summary: No blocking security defects: injection paths stay shlex-quoted, lock single-writer hardening is sound, and harness names are validated before any destructive path; two low findings remain on unvalidated config.json shape and an asymmetric history commit stamp.

findings.summary: config.json that parses but has the wrong shape crashes the install with a raw AttributeError traceback instead of a clean named-file error (ENG-25, ENG-17; SC-002 zero tracebacks).
findings.evidence: config_models does json.loads(...).get('models', {}).get(name, {}); install.sh guard (46-56) checks parse validity only. Demonstrated: config.json '[]' aborts ./install.sh with AttributeError. Raises before rmtree, nothing deleted.
findings.fix: isinstance checks in config_models, or catch AttributeError and exit with a message naming the config path.

findings.summary: Checkpoint stamps the commit SHA only when the entry was reused on retry, so a fresh successful checkpoint records commit: null, indistinguishable from a failed commit (ENG-26).
findings.evidence: The only fill is 'if commit and reused and updated.get("history")'; data-model.md defines commit as part of the durable history shape.
findings.fix: Stamp the trailing entry with the landed SHA on every successful commit.
